messages:
emma-partners: quick sync: launching an SI onramp tied to a hardware bundle in the marketplace. need clear lead-handling rules, account mapping CSV, and kit reservation policy. 3-week target.
jay-sales: sounds good. i'll run a sweep of mid+enterprise opps and flag anything in demo/POC. will post claims tonight.
mira-si: request: SI claims accepted only when POI>=2 OR a demo scheduled. also require a 1-paragraph integration summary attached to the claim.
oscar-hw: inventory note: limited rack kits. when a claim includes `qty_needed` we can reserve for 10 business days. need SKU list + lead times by EOD.
emma-partners: proposed CSV columns: acct_id,acct_name,current_owner,region,stage,si_claim,claim_ts,claim_basis,poi_score,qty_needed,expected_phase,claim_source.
lucy-comm: add comms guardrail: no customer quotes or logos in marketplace listing without written consent and comms signoff. also run legal on joint announcement language.
jay-sales: conflict policy idea: (1) AE with active forecast retains ownership; (2) SI with signed NDA/SOW or poi_score>=3 wins; (3) marketplace-origin leads routed to marketplace team. escalate ties to @lucy-comm.
mira-si: SLA: SI responds to claim within 48h with next-step (demo scheduled / more info). miss = ownership reverts to AE and tag `si_unresponsive`.
oscar-hw: will upload /shared/hw/sku_reservations.csv with `sku,qty_allocated,lead_time,reserved_until` by EOD.
ops-bot: calendar created: "SI onramp + HW reservations" Thu 11:00am PT 1 attendees emma-partners, jay-sales, mira-si, oscar-hw, lucy-comm.
emma-partners: action items: jay = sweep + upload claims, oscar = SKU CSV, mira = demo intake link + SE rotation, lucy = comms/legal review. i'll merge into ROE doc and post for review. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
